investor.question: How do I find out more?
investor.answer: Request the investor pack on this page, or join a community call and ask the team directly.

steward.question: How do I find a role?
steward.answer: Every role is on the Roles page, with the work it holds. Pick one that fits you and apply from there.

resident.question: Can I visit before I decide?
resident.answer: Yes. Plan a visit from the Visit page, or join a community call first to meet the people here.

prosperity.question: How do I bring a business here?
prosperity.answer: Send a proposal from the Work With Us page, with what you want to build and what you would need. The team will talk it through with you.
